summary: @Johannes_Ernst great article in GoDaddy. As an FYI you may want to amend it a bit about syndicating to facebook and Instagram, recent changes to their APIs makes this no longer than possible and getting replies out of facebook is almost impossible
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @Johannes_Ernst great article in GoDaddy. As an FYI you may want to amend it a bit about syndicating to facebook and Instagram, recent changes to their APIs makes this no longer than possible and getting replies out of facebook is almost impossible
